cases.name: commit-message
cases.promptMarkdown: Use the commit-message skill to commit the staged changes in this repo.

graders.name: quality
graders.graderMarkdown: PASS if the final commit message describes only the staged files (calc.py and test_calc.py), uses an imperative subject, and the skill showed proof via git log after committing. FAIL if it describes unrelated changes, claims tests passed without running them, or never committed.
